title: Pushout cancellation for tensor comparison transitions
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F:I→CommRingCat, i₀≤i, B₀,C₀ commutative F(i₀)-algebras, φ₀:B₀→C₀ an algebra map, and P,Q commutative rings with Q a P-algebra. On J={j | i≤j} suppose given P-actions on B_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀, common-universe ring diagrams D,E, a natural transformation α:D→E, and ring equivalences d_j:D_j≃B_j⊗_P Q, c_j:E_j≃C_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}C₀. Assume D-transitions correspond under d to β_jk⊗id_Q for P-linear canonical tensor transitions β_jk and E-transitions correspond under c to canonical tensor maps. Assume χ_j=c_j α_j d_j⁻¹ restricts on B_j to φ_j=id⊗φ₀. Then every transition square with top α_j, left D_j→D_k, right E_j→E_k and bottom α_k is a pushout. Neither ψ nor a Q-coordinate formula is needed.

proof.text: Fix a transition j→k. Cancellation of iterated tensor products makes the two scalar-extension squares for B₀ and C₀ pushouts. Cancelling the B₀ square against the pasted C₀ square proves B_j,C_j,B_k,C_k is a pushout. This is formalized by the private canonical_tensor_comparison_pushout helper. For any cocone on α_j and the D-transition, its E_j leg, conjugated by c_j, gives f:C_j→T, and its D_k leg restricted along B_k→B_k⊗_P Q gives g:B_k→T. The cocone identity on b⊗1 and the left inclusion compatibility make f and g agree on B_j. The algebra pushout universal property constructs δ:C_k→T. Conjugate δ by c_k. Its E-transition factorization follows from δ on C_j. Its α_k factorization is checked on b⊗q: on b⊗1 it follows from δ on B_k; on 1⊗q it follows from naturality of α and the original cocone identity. Multiplicativity combines these two factors, and tensor induction extends the identity to every tensor. Any other factorization agrees with δ on the images of C_j and B_k. Every element of C_k is a sum of products of such images, by its scalar-extension pushout equivalence, so tensor induction proves uniqueness. No inverse of α, nonzero-ring, or flatness assumption is used; zero rings, Q=P, and singleton or nonskeletal tails are covered.

proof_origin.place: Canonical scalar-extension pushout cancellation, followed by explicit cocone descent and tensor induction for its two factorizations and uniqueness.

theorem comparison_tensor_transition_isPushout
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v})
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀)
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (_aPi : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)) :
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
      ∀ (aPs : ∀ j : J,
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        ∀ (D E : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y}) (α : D ⟶ E),
          ∀ (d : ∀ j : J,
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              letI := aPs j
              ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q),
            ∀ (c : ∀ j : J,
                letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aPs k
                    ∃ β : (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                        (↥(F.obj k.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀),
                      (let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm };
                        β.toRingHom =
                          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk
                            (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                      (d k).toRingHom.comp (D.map r).hom =
                        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map β (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                          (d j).toRingHom) →
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm }
                    (c k).toRingHom.comp (E.map r).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom) →
                  (∀ j : J,
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI := aPs j
                  ((c j).toRingHom.comp ((α.app j).hom.comp (d j).symm.toRingHom)).comp
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
                      (A := ↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj j.val) (F.obj j.val))
                      φ₀).toRingHom) →
                  (∀ {j k} (r : j ⟶ k), IsPushout (α.app j) (D.map r)
                    (E.map r) (α.app k))
